entries.title: Psalms 146:1
segments: ¶Let the Lord be praised. Give praise to the Lord, O my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 146:2
segments: While I have breath I will give praise to the Lord: I will make melody to my God while I have my being.

entries.title: Psalms 146:3
segments: Put not your faith in rulers, or in the son of man, in whom there is no salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 146:4
segments: Man's breath goes out, he is turned back again to dust; in that day all his purposes come to an end.

entries.title: Psalms 146:5
segments: ¶Happy is the man who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the Lord his God:

entries.title: Psalms 146:6
segments: Who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all things in them; who keeps faith for ever:

entries.title: Psalms 146:7
segments: Who gives their rights to those who are crushed down; and gives food to those who are in need of it: the Lord makes the prisoners free;

entries.title: Psalms 146:8
segments: The Lord makes open the eyes of the blind; the Lord is the lifter up of those who are bent down; the Lord is a lover of the upright;

entries.title: Psalms 146:9
segments: The Lord takes care of those who are in a strange land; he gives help to the widow and to the child who has no father; but he sends destruction on the way of sinners.

entries.title: Psalms 146:10
segments: The Lord will be King for ever; your God, O Zion, will be King through all generations. Praise be to the Lord.
